checkpoints.description: [1/6] Plan: port outline/brief, manifest, AI artifacts and bundle export into the Rust crate

impact_assessment.why: The first rewrite task closed with the schema-14 core, graph, evidence, cascades, reports, measurements, search and analysis ported; the remaining runtime-critical surface and outer layers still run only in Python.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every command the engine exposes will have a Rust implementation backed by the same SQLite graph, with parity tests before the Python entry point is retired.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: JSON/text shapes, manifest digests and bundle formats must match Python exactly; dependency: only declared crates and the shared graph; concurrency: other agents are editing AIKit's native gates, so project gates must be verified with direct scripts when the root native bridge is stale; state: existing research.db files must stay readable.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Read each Python module before porting; add CLI-level parity scripts for every subsystem; keep new Rust modules pure and dependency-light; verify with cargo test plus direct hygiene/KB/secret/test scripts.

checkpoints.description: [1/6] Plan: port remaining lattice repository/analysis/snapshots, studio and domains modules, then switch the runtime entry point to Rust

impact_assessment.why: The prior rewrite task closed with the core, analysis, AI, experiments and first lattice parsers ported, but the outer layers and runtime entry point remain Python-only.
impact_assessment.benefits: A complete Rust runtime with no Python-only surface; the shared SQLite graph and parity harnesses let each layer be ported and verified independently.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: lattice schema v2 and studio/domain APIs must stay compatible; dependency: only declared crates; concurrency: ledger owned by opencode:rust-rewrite; state: existing graph files and lattice databases must remain readable.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Port bounded modules with Python parity helpers, keep separate schema initialization for lattice stores, verify with cargo test plus direct hygiene/KB/secret/test scripts before each commit.
